## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
Unchanged-value adoption should preserve the configuration file’s bytes; it currently rewrites files even when no setting changes.

## Changes
The pull request adds adoption mode, records adopted keys, and adds tests for adoption and replacement with differing values.

## Critical
(none)

## Important
- app/config.py:15 — correctness — Preserve unchanged files during adoption — With a file containing `{"theme":"dark"}`, calling `merge(path, {"theme": "dark"}, adopt=True)` reformats the file without changing any setting. Unconditionally appending the key triggers serialization, violating the module’s stated preservation behavior. — Users lose existing configuration formatting when adopting settings that already match.
